mr_title: Improve caching by comparing file hashes as fallback for mtime and size

expected_issues.title: Cache compares mtimes truncated to whole seconds
expected_issues.description:
The cache compares mtimes truncated to whole seconds, so a file edited within the same second and with the same size is considered unchanged and is not reformatted/checked.

is_changed() only falls back to the content hash when the (integer) mtime differs. Two writes within one second that keep the size identical (e.g. a one-character edit by a tool, or a git checkout followed by an immediate run) keep int(mtime) equal, so the hash is never compared and black reports the file as unchanged from the stale cache. Compare the full-precision mtime.
